title: Sutra CloudEvent context (B-12, version 1.0.0)
description: The CloudEvents 1.0 context attributes Sutra sets on every outgoing webhook. They travel in HTTP binary content mode as ce-<attribute> headers; the request body is the webhook's own body, unchanged. Source of truth: src/sutra/sources/cloudevents.clj.

id.description: Unique per delivery. A delivery from the action outbox keeps its outbox key across retries, so it equals the Idempotency-Key header; a receiver de-duplicates on source + id.

source.description: The data connection source the webhook belongs to.

subject.description: The webhook's name within the source.

types.com.sutra.actions.webhook: an action called a source's webhook
types.com.sutra.sources.webhook: a webhook called outside an action
types.com.sutra.sources.writeback-create: a writeback created a record through a webhook
